verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents its own invoicing and online-payments features, and says users can create invoices and track payments, including through its MCP/AI hooks. The evidence is mostly feature headings and marketing lines, though. Nothing shows invoice delivery to customers, the online payment options embedded in invoices, or tracking when an invoice is viewed. Missing for 10: documented invoice sending/delivery, payment links or gateways on invoices, viewed-status tracking, in-depth invoicing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid
